links.comparator_used: Same LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek R1) without RAG, relying on training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Accuracy on 38 open-ended ACS guideline-based questions, scored against guideline recommendations with an AI similarity score tool
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o 71.1% without RAG vs 92.1% with RAG (P = 0.017); DeepSeek R1 78.9% without RAG vs 94.7% with RAG (no P value reported for this pair). RAG disproportionately improved lower-scoring questions in DeepSeek R1 and improved scores more evenly in ChatGPT-4o.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o without RAG achieved 71.1% accuracy (95% CI: 55.2%-83.0%), which significantly improved with RAG (P = 0.017).

links.comparator_used: General-purpose models (ChatGPT-4o, DeepSeek R1) without RAG, used zero-shot
links.effect: Med-PaLM 2 (medicine-specific) 68.4% vs DeepSeek R1 without RAG 78.9% and ChatGPT-4o without RAG 71.1%
links.quote: Med-PaLM 2 had the lowest accuracy (68.4%; 95% CI: 52.5%-80.9%).
